titleDv: ގާނޫނު ނަންބަރު 5/2009 (ބިންގަޑު ދަތުރުފަތުރުގެ ގާނޫނު) އަށް .. ވަނަ އިޞްލާޙު ގެނައުމުގެ ބިލު
summary: This bill amends the Land Transport Act (Law No. 5/2009). It changes four articles (22, 63, 67 and 70) that deal with driving offences, penalties and driving licences. The clearest changes are to fines: a new MVR 25,000 fine is added to Article 22, and the fines in Article 67 rise from roughly MVR 1,000 to 2,000 to between MVR 10,000 and 50,000, with a separate MVR 5,000 fine. Article 63 gets new penalty wording that also refers to the Penal Code (Law 9/2014). The scans are hard to read, so the exact offences each change covers are uncertain.
whyItMatters: If passed, some road and licence offences would carry much higher fines, and people could face licence consequences for them.
keyProvisions: Article 22: a new clause (e) adds a fine of MVR 25,000 (twenty-five thousand rufiyaa) for the cases covered by the earlier clauses of that article.

Article 63: clause (a) is rewritten into a numbered list of five items, and a new clause refers to the Penal Code (Law 9/2014) and to suspension periods (3 to 6 months and 10 to 25 days appear in the text).

Article 67(h): the penalty table is replaced. The current text has fines of about MVR 1,000, 1,500 and 2,000; the proposed text sets a fine of MVR 10,000 to 50,000 and a separate fine of MVR 5,000. The first amount appears to apply to an under-18 driver, but this is uncertain.
Article 70(a) is reworded and an extra parenthetical phrase is added; the change could not be read reliably.
Pages 4 to 7 contain a side-by-side table of the current text and the proposed text for each change.
whoIsAffected: Drivers and vehicle owners, and especially people accused of the offences covered by Articles 22, 63, 67 and 70.
statedReasons: An explanatory note is printed on page 2, but the scan is too hard to read, so no reason is reported here.
